analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 RSI 중립 구간 횡보 지속. MACD 히스토그램은 5일 전 964.7165에서 현재 679.1254로 악화되며 상승 동력 부재 확인. 52주 위치 54.1%로 박스권 상단 저항선 36,570원 부근에서 매물 소화 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI has been consolidating in the neutral zone for 3 consecutive sessions. MACD histogram has worsened from 964.7165 to 679.1254, confirming a lack of upward momentum. At 54.1% of its 52-week range, the price needs to digest resistance near the 36,570 won swing resistance level.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (964.7165→679.1254) + 악화 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 미약

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.92배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 보통
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 36,570원 돌파 시 매수, 34,485원 이탈 시 매도 고려
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 35,805) vs SMA5 (KRW 35,455)/SMA20 (KRW 33,540)/SMA50 (KRW 39,336): above short-term, below mid-term
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 41,242)/SMA200 (KRW 33,002): mid-to-long term trend weak
· 52-week position (54.1%) + current price range in historical neutral zone
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.3→50.7) + neutral assessment + weakening directionality
· MACD histogram trajectory (964.7165→679.1254) + worsening diagnosis + weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band KRW 33,540) + band width 29.81% indicating moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 34,485) + based on pivot (KRW 33,527)
· Swing resistance (KRW 36,570) + potential for short-term upward reversal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of trend directionality
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.92x) + moderate confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + consider buying on break above KRW 36,570, selling on break below KRW 34,485
